caption:
The sun dropped right where the cliff meets the sea, so we cut the speed and let the foam do the talking.
Up on the ridge you can still see the little houses catching the last light.
Half the sky orange, half of it already deep blue.
Link in bio if you want the quiet version of Madeira.
